exposure: mothers' work and lack of nursery at the workplace
cohort: The study included 380 mothers with infants aged 2 weeks to 6 months old.
finding: Mixed feeding was the most common breastfeeding practice in South Jordan (57.63%), with exclusive breastfeeding at 24%, and mothers' work and lack of nursery at the workplace being the most noticeable barrier.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as a predictor of breastfeeding practices.
cross-section timing: When infants were 2 weeks to 6 months old
